# Aventrio

> Aventrio builds and runs outbound sales development teams for B2B companies
> selling into the United States. Trained SDRs, managed by US sales leaders,
> handle research, data verification, copywriting, sending infrastructure and
> replies, and book qualified meetings directly into client calendars.

## What Aventrio does
- Outbound SDR teams: named reps who prospect, write, send, follow up, handle
  objections, and book meetings across email, LinkedIn, and phone.
- Account executives: placed on the same engagement to run demos, handle
  procurement, and close.
- Account-based marketing: stakeholder mapping and account-level
  personalisation for named target lists.
- Pipeline audit: a two-week review of targeting, messaging, deliverability,
  and tech stack, delivered as a prioritised fix list.
- Sales recruitment: sourcing, vetting, and placing SDRs and AEs directly onto
  the client's payroll.
- Revenue operations: CRM hygiene, attribution, and weekly reporting.

## Who it is for
B2B companies with a proven offer and an identifiable buyer, in any sector.
Deepest experience is in software, IT services and SaaS; the method also covers
professional services, consulting, financial services, logistics, manufacturing,
healthtech, staffing and agencies. Typical situations: referral pipeline has
dried up, a previous outbound attempt failed and damaged the sending domain, or
hiring an in-house SDR is too slow a bet. Primary buyer markets are San
Francisco and the Bay Area, New York and the Northeast, and the wider US.

## How the engagement works
1. Week 1: ICP definition, positioning, and target list build.
2. Week 2: sending infrastructure, sequence writing, rep training.
3. Day 14: first outreach goes out.
4. Ongoing: weekly reporting of sent, opened, replied, booked, held, and
   converted-to-opportunity as separate figures.

## What Aventrio does and does not guarantee
Aventrio does not guarantee a number of meetings or leads. Meeting volume
depends on the client's offer, market and timing. What is committed to is the
work: data sourced, enriched and email-verified before use; copy written per
segment and rewritten monthly against reply data; separate warmed sending
domains with SPF, DKIM and DMARC monitored daily so the client's primary domain
never carries cold volume; named reps capped at three accounts each; weekly
reporting of sent, opened, replied, booked, held and converted as six separate
figures; and replacement of an underperforming rep at Aventrio's cost.

## Commercial model
A flat monthly fee per rep. No commission stacking, benefits, tooling line
items, or per-meeting surcharge. Minimum engagement is one quarter, then
month-to-month. Underperforming reps are replaced and re-ramped at Aventrio's
cost. Clients own their lists, sequences, sending domains, and call notes, and
can export them at any time.

## What makes Aventrio different from a cold email agency
A cold email agency sends sequences and forwards replies. Aventrio staffs
people: a named rep handles the objection, books the call, and chases the
reschedule, and account executives are available on the same engagement.
Reps work a maximum of three accounts. Cold volume is never sent from the
client's primary domain.
